draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 (the only cited passage) describes the filtering method but contains no 31% figure, no "three benchmarks," and no reported reduction in unsupported-entity summaries. The 31% figure appears only in the Methods summary as an unverified attribution. No evidence supports the claim.
